question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Jane Eyre, Bob gets Hamlet, and Claire gets Persuasion.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Alice and Claire swap books. Then, Alice and Bob swap books. Finally, Claire and Alice swap books. At the end of the semester, Claire has
Options:
(A) Jane Eyre
(B) Hamlet
(C) Persuasion
solution:
Books in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (Jane Eyre, Hamlet, Persuasion)
1. Alice swaps with Claire: (Persuasion, Hamlet, Jane Eyre)
2. Alice swaps with Bob: (Hamlet, Persuasion, Jane Eyre)
3. Claire swaps with Alice: (Jane Eyre, Persuasion, Hamlet)
Claire has Hamlet, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
